name: smwgraphics-mega-man-x3-ruins-of-dr-doppler-s-lab-ending
title: Mega Man X3 - Ruins of Dr. Doppler's Lab (Ending)
description:
The background that appears in the ending of Mega Man X3.

Massive update! Now it has been ripped with accuracy, at the cost one extra palette row. Includes the laboratory before it explodes and the ruined version.

Uses a big map 16 because the tilemap of the game has the two backgrounds tied together, which is changed as the laboratory explodes.
